The app must clearly indicate in its description, screenshots and previews whether any featured items, levels or subscriptions require additional purchases.

If any configured in-app purchase items cannot be found or reviewed in the app, the app must explain the reason in the review notes.
Paid digital content, services, or functionality in the app must be sold through in-app purchase, not by other means.
Configure IAP products in App Store Connect and confirm they are Ready to Submit.
Generate a new iOS build after configuring in-app products and integrating IAP, and attach it to the resubmission.
The app must show exact pricing before the purchase button.
Certificates delivered as physical items may use external payment methods instead of in-app purchase.
Digital goods such as subscriptions and in-app content must use Google Play Billing; alternative payment methods are not allowed.
Provide a privacy policy URL in Play Console and a privacy policy link accessible inside the app.
The app may not require payment or indirectly monetize access to the Apple Music service, such as through in-app purchase, advertising or requesting user info.
Apps using Apple Pay must use Apple Pay branding and user interface elements correctly, as described in the Apple Pay Marketing Guidelines and Human Interface Guidelines.
Apps using Apple Pay must provide all material purchase information to the user before the sale of any good or service.
Apps using Apple Pay may only share user data acquired via Apple Pay with third parties to facilitate or improve delivery of goods and services.
Apps offering user-generated creator content must follow Guideline 3.1.1 for payments and in-app purchases and communicate to users which content requires additional purchases.
The Data Safety section must accurately declare data collection, including purchase history, email addresses, device IDs and analytics data.
Software offered under this rule must follow Guideline 3.1 to offer digital goods or services to end users.
Do not advertise, promote, or link to external payment methods or purchase flows from within the app; IAP must remain the primary purchase path.
Create sandbox test accounts in App Store Connect and configure them on the device under Settings > App Store > Sandbox.
Add test accounts in Play Console for license testing of purchases.
Each permission request must have a clear, specific explanation, state how data is stored or shared, and say whether it is optional.
Privacy labels must be accurate to avoid rejection.
Use StoreKit to fetch and process purchases, and grant access only after the purchase is processed.
